project.summary: Make one complete creator-selected Etude Fantasia matchup run through the compiled semantic runtime as the exercised production authority for human play, replay, and agent belief/search. Drive real play, replay, and agent interaction through typed program
project.definition: Make one complete creator-selected Etude Fantasia matchup run through the compiled semantic runtime as the exercised production authority for human play, replay, and agent belief/search. Drive real play, replay, and agent interaction through typed programs, structured offers and Commands, canonical events, and stable viewer-safe public-commitment identities owned by managym; measure the world as played and use focused diagnostics only when its behavior is surprising. Provider closure on the selected matchup remains the admission priority and cannot be substituted or weakened by content work; the already-approved single next-content vertical slice may implement in parallel as a separate proof.

krs.text: A deterministic release-stack UR Lessons versus GW Allies match reaches terminal with every encountered card behavior executed from admitted typed programs and every player decision submitted through structured InteractionOffer and Command values, with no card-name dispatch, candidate cap, or client-side legality in the trace.

Live play, headless engine play, and canonical replay reproduce the same state witnesses and ordered semantic consequences for fixed terminal seeds, while viewer-private facts and stale ObjectRef values remain inaccessible at their public boundaries.

The selected matchup exposes every reachable prompt family needed by its real cards through structured offers, including targeting and combinatorial combat, and records zero legacy fixed-action fallback for the exercised release traces.

Across a fixed terminal UR Lessons versus GW Allies trace, every admitted public commitment consumed by exact-range belief tracking carries a stable viewer-safe managym-owned identity that reproduces live, in canonical replay, and on an exact fork; the exercised RulesProviderGap count is zero, unsupported commitments fail closed without match or belief mutation, and no hidden truth enters the public Observation or receipt.

A release and training workload records command p50/p95 latency, step and complete-game throughput, peak RSS, semantic-program token counts, and fallback counters; the compiled path stays within explicit product and rollout budgets.

One subsequent creator-selected card or mechanic increment is admitted as a playable vertical slice and records whether the change was content-only or required a reusable IR or kernel extension, with terminal play evidence rather than coverage markers alone.

task.description: Advance only the remaining Playable Curated World workload-budget KR using the observed RUL-9 release miss as the diagnostic input. Make the smallest reusable production-path change that can bring fixed UR Lessons versus GW Allies live Command p95 to <=100 ms and complete-game throughput to >=1.0 games/s. Then record a new source- and binary-bound measurement receipt over the same semantic Command authority, including p50/p95, step and game throughput, peak RSS, semantic-program token counts/overflow, and all fallback counters. Preserve exact live/headless/persisted-replay witnesses and ordered consequences, privacy/stale-reference rejection, zero legacy/card-name/candidate-cap/client-legality fallback, and the retained full_clone/current_game_v1 training budgets. Out of scope: content breadth, representation replacement, public-commitment ontology, weakening budgets, or editing frozen RUL-9 artifacts. task.name: Prove authored match parity across live, headless, and replay
task.description:
Close Playable Curated World KR2 using the merged PR #136 seed-0 UR Lessons versus GW Allies authored-match receipt as the fixed authority trace. Reuse its exact revision-bound Command sequence; do not regenerate a different policy trace. Execute that sequence through (1) the release-stack live play boundary, (2) direct headless engine play, and (3) canonical replay. At every revision—not only terminal—compare stable state witnesses and the ordered semantic consequences visible at the authoritative boundary, and report the first divergence with revision and source identity. Bind the result to a reproducible relevant-source digest and provide a single checked command that verifies it from another checkout. Exercise public viewer boundaries for both players and any admitted spectator/replay viewer: private hand/library/choice facts must remain inaccessible. Capture a valid ObjectRef, cause its incarnation to become stale, submit it through the normal public Command boundary, and prove typed rejection with unchanged state witness and event cursor. Add focused regression tests only for seams exposed by this real trace. If implementation is missing, make the smallest reusable parity/projection/replay fix and replay immediately. Do not reopen compiled authority or prompt coverage, add workload benchmarking, new cards/content, broad conformance, or a parallel replay engine. Run Rust tests in debug; run every Python command through uv; rebuild the extension after managym/src changes. Done when a checked-in revision-bound receipt proves exact live/headless/replay witness and ordered-consequence parity for the fixed trace, viewer-private facts stay hidden at every public surface, stale ObjectRef submission is rejected atomically, focused tests pass, and the receipt survives verification from another checkout.
